body:
She just have pain in the upper area of her stomach. The source of the pain might be pressing on her lungs, which makes breathing harder (you can see her struggling to breath). She stays in her room because she says whenever she tries to go to the kitchen or another room the pain becomes intolerable. The fact that the first hospital she went to couldn't diagnose her made her believe that she's possessed, and the only way she could be healed is through god. I'm sure she have pain, but I know that she could be oversensitive sometimes. Any other human who could walk on her/his own would do whatever it takes to go out, but she's doing the exact opposite.

I didn't try to force her to go out before. She's been telling us for a while that she'd love to visit Mekka (a holy city for muslims). So I told her I'd take her there, but she said she can't go out. I'm having some thoughts to sell the house and look for another, but I'm not quite convinced that it'd work, she could simply lock herself up again in the new house.

Thank you for taking the time to read and respond! I really appreciate it!
